name: Hashabneiah
overview: Hashabneiah was a male Levite known for his role in exhorting Israel to bless the Lord, as recorded in Nehemiah 9:5. His identity as a member of the tribe of Levi places him within the priestly lineage, emphasizing his spiritual leadership among God's people. Beyond this, Scripture does not provide additional personal details or notes about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Hashabneiah likely means 'YHWH has considered me,' reflecting a theologically rich understanding of God's attentive care. This proper name highlights a personal connection to the Lord, consistent with his Levite heritage and spiritual responsibilities.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Hashabneiah as a descendant of Levi, linking him to the priestly tribe chosen for service to God. No other family relationships are recorded beyond this tribal affiliation.
scriptureSignificance: Hashabneiah's significance lies in his leadership role during a pivotal moment when Israel was called to bless the Lord, demonstrating his active participation in corporate worship and spiritual renewal. His Levite background underscores the importance of the priestly tribe in guiding Israel's devotion and obedience to God. Through his exhortation, Hashabneiah contributed to the communal recognition of God's faithfulness and sovereignty.
